issue_checked: The shared Signy parsing metadata flags season 2008 because a source comment matches the pre-existing replication regex.
finding: The 2008 source comment states that logistical constraints prevented fledgling counts at the optimum time and that chick/fledgling-derived quantities are unreliable for that season. It does not state that breeding-pair counts are unreliable.
endpoint_relevance: The concentration replication uses TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_PAIRS only; no chick or fledgling quantity enters N_eff, the slope, or the fixed-composition null.
additional_source_context: The source records ecological nest abandonment and snow/meltwater impacts in the late-2000s decline period.
These comments describe biological conditions and do not define a measurement-based reason to exclude the corresponding breeding-pair season from the already-frozen primary epoch.
decision: Retain the frozen 1998-2009 primary concentration result unchanged. Do not create a post-outcome season-exclusion sensitivity.
boundary: This audit does not assert that all Signy measurements are error-free.
It only distinguishes the comment-flag reason from the breeding-pair endpoint used in the concentration test.
No year is removed after observing the concentration result.
